b.lede: Nvidia is introducing a 64GB version of its DGX Spark local AI workstation that's tailored for a new generation of highly intelligent yet compact local models. Starting at $4999, the more affordable configuration is otherwise identical to the original 128GB Spark and its GB10 siblings.
b.title: Nvidia introduces 64GB DGX Spark to throw local AI fans a lifeline amid the RAMpocalypse
